notes: An invite for a new person; it works once, for 24 hours. The token and link are shown only in this answer: the server keeps a hash. The link is for the QR code and for sending. POST /api/users/{id}/invites (no body) makes one that adds a phone for someone with an account, with their name and role. folders are the folders a new member will see, possibly none, and must be given for a member (400 bad_request without); an admin sees every folder, so they don't count for one. Errors: bad_request (400) for a missing name or an unknown role, not_found (404) for an unknown person or folder. With encrypted folders, keys holds every version of the keys of the encrypted folders the person gets (all of them for an admin), locked with a secret the inviting device adds to the link after a dot (/join#<token>.<secret>), which the server never sees: [{"folder", "version", "locked"}]. POST /api/users/{id}/invites (a new phone or browser) takes {"person_key": the person's key locked the same way}. Accepting returns them (invite_accept.json); without them the new device waits for others to seal its keys.
